changes: GCCのx86だけ、CompactSlotを未構築のunion領域にし、登録時にstd::construct_atで値を構築。
新規領域の値を構築する前に、約4096/sizeof(Slot)スロット間隔（最低1）のバイト書き込みで領域を準備する。
前回のSSE2再配置、公開API、通常の探索・更新・削除とmain/入出力は維持。
Clang・他対象環境は従来のstructと初期化を維持。

conditions.main_seed: 実装の実行時seedを変更していない。各プロセスで異なる。
conditions.wide_insert_includes: 表の構築・追加・破棄を含む。その他の直接操作は構築後のループ。

storage_experiments_and_focused_tests.decision: GCC x86でunion未構築スロットとページ間隔の事前書き込みを採用候補とする。Clangは元の構造体と全スロット初期化を維持。
storage_experiments_and_focused_tests.official_cases: /tmp/sirkit_hash_map_20261022/cases; all observed outputs match independent std::map answers and published answer SHA256
storage_experiments_and_focused_tests.main_seed: GenericHash runtime seed unchanged, differs each process

pure_union.decision: Pure union alone improves insertion but regresses large hit and several official mixed cases. Reject.

prefault_diagnostics.decision: page4096/line64 touches restore large hit performance; zero-all largely loses insertion gain. These byte-pointer-across-array forms are diagnostics, not final production recommendation.

focused_per_slot_final_candidate.decision: GCC page_slot performs best across4 representative official cases; focused hit/miss/update/churn show no repeated meaningful regression. Clang page_slot has clear regressions, so preserve original Clang implementation.

safety_notes: Empty user-provided union constructor does not initialize inactive value member. Construct value only on insertion, keep temporary next, no destroy_at on a potentially inactive member.
State0 is never read as value. State2 retains constructed value, including after copying the union. Union implicit copy constructor starts corresponding active member lifetimes.
Only fresh slots before any active value construction receive volatile unsigned-char first-byte stores. Use addressof(next[i]) per slot, not pointer arithmetic across separate object representations.
General eligibility does not imply is_trivially_copyable for custom nontrivial move types. No new generic raw bulk copy is introduced; retain implicit union copy semantics.
sizeof(Slot) may exceed page stride. Then stride is1 and only first byte per slot is touched. No complete page-touch or bandwidth guarantee is claimed for such types.
limitations: All speed data local to Intel Core i9-14900K. Online submission412356117ms is the baseline, not the new candidate.
Official main measurements include startup/IO; do not call the main ratio a library-only ratio.
Main hashes/steps/IO frozen; runtime hash seed varies by process. Baseline/control sometimes vary several percent.
Focused kernel template<Op> removes runtime operation-selector branch; it is a separate direct API measurement, not the actual Verify main.
Focused5round3seed tests resolve old runtime-op microbenchmark update/miss worries. Root performs final7round official all20 and additional widths independently.
Memory touches restore hit performance, but exact OS page-placement/cache cause is not established.

Clang focused kernels can call insertion_slot out of line. Kernel normalized asm equality alone is not full end-to-end call-tree equivalence. GCC focused hit/miss/update/churn hot probes inline and do not allocate in these workloads.
ローカル測定。新版本体のオンライン判定・時間は未確認。117msは改修前129eeaf版の結果。
公式ケースは同一main/入出力を含む実行時間。API単体の倍率とは区別する。
小規模ケースでは起動・入出力費用が大きく、baseline/control間にも変動がある。全ケース改善とはしない。
単純な未構築unionのみでは大規模検索が遅くなり、不採用。事前書き込みで改善した事実は確認したが、ページフォルト/cache/TLB等の具体的原因は計測していない。
過剰alignment値の小規模更新では複合ベンチで0.24nsの差があった。専用試験のseed123/777では同等、194734ではbaseline1.255/control1.303/final1.353ns。命令列は再配置先を除いて同一だが、特定条件の微小な遅れは残る。
小規模操作の命令位置・分岐予測等に依存する時間差まで、一律に後退なしとは主張しない。
